data.one_liner: A simple way to cache values that result from expensive operations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CachedValue class that stores computed values and avoids recalculating them on every access. Supports manual invalidation, declarative dependencies, and time-to-live (TTL) expiration.
use_when: You need to cache results of expensive operations or object instances across frames in render objects.
Values need to be automatically invalidated when specified dependencies change.
Values should expire automatically after a specific time-to-live duration.
avoid_when: You need persistent storage across app restarts.
Your dependency callback performs expensive operations.
strengths: Simple and lightweight API for memory caching
Supports declarative dependency tracking and TTL out of the box
Useful for performance optimization in render objects and paint routines
weaknesses: Memory-only cache with no built-in disk persistence
Dependency callbacks are executed on every value access
